---
description: Draft an Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
---

Draft an ADR using `docs/adr/template.md`.

I will give you: the decision to make, the options I am considering, our constraints and our team's skills.

Requirements:

1. Compare at least three options in a table against clear decision drivers.
2. Respect the allowed technologies in `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (ARC-10).
3. Write the consequences honestly, including the downsides and how we handle them.
4. Mark every fact you are not sure about with `[verify]` so I can check it.
5. Write in plain English and keep it under two pages.
